data.change_summary: Stabilized the new molt/mineral regressions so they isolate mineral effects deterministically and updated the shrimp reproduction budget fixture to seed explicit Ca/Mg support required by the molt model. The 1000-hour `hard_shrimp` vs `ro_like` survival comparison, failed-molt mortality regression, and broader closed-system budget coverage now pass against the existing stage-aware molt implementation in this branch.

steps.description: Adjusted the long-horizon molt/mineral tests to freeze condition drift and feeding noise so the soft-vs-hard water and failed-molt mortality assertions measure mineral-driven behavior deterministically.
Updated the shrimp reproduction budget fixture to include explicit calcium and magnesium support so the closed-system reproduction conservation test remains valid with mineral-gated molting.
Ran targeted regressions plus full `tank_core`, `tank_data`, and `tank_scenarios` test suites to verify the fixes end to end.
